name: A Mechanical Raven's Egg
source:
Freshly escaped and desperate to avoid recognition, a rogue android finds the first safe harbor that will take them – an illegal repair shop they quickly learn is manned by another android.  In lieu of the cosmetic repairs that they can't afford comes instead a gentle, if clumsy, exploration of social presentation that leads them to question their identity for the first time.

[from [url=https://moleworks.itch.io/a-mechanical-ravens-egg]itch.io[/url]]
